department: Department for Welfare of SC/ST/OBC, GNCTD

eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Delhi (NCT) resident studying in recognised Delhi school (DoE/MCD/NDMC/KV); Gurugram/Faridabad/Noida/Ghaziabad excluded.
eligibility_criteria.age_range: School students in Classes IX–XII (typically 13–19 years)
eligibility_criteria.income_cap: Up to ₹8,00,000/year (waived if >=75% marks in previous class [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION])
eligibility_criteria.category_rules: SC/ST/OBC with >=50% marks in previous class (IX–X) or >=60% marks (XI–XII).
eligibility_criteria.academic_or_work_rules: Enrolled in Classes IX–XII at a recognised Delhi school.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Outside Delhi NCT schools/residents and repeaters.

benefit.summary_hi: कक्षा 9–10 के लिए ₹5,000/वर्ष और कक्षा 11–12 के लिए ₹10,000/वर्ष की डीबीटी छात्रवृत्ति सहायता।

benefit_summary.hi: कक्षा 9–10 के लिए ₹5,000/वर्ष और कक्षा 11–12 के लिए ₹10,000/वर्ष की डीबीटी छात्रवृत्ति सहायता।

application_steps.online: Apply on edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in through school verification.
application_steps.offline: Submit verified application at recognised school nodal desk or Citizen Facilitation Centre (CFC).
application_steps.facilitation_center: Citizen Facilitation Centre (CFC) / School Nodal Desk

verification_note.hi: नोट ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): वर्तमान 2026–27 सक्रिय आवेदन विंडो, स्लैब व अंतिम नियम कृपया आधिकारिक सरकारी पोर्टल पर सत्यापित करें।
verification_note.en: Notice ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): Always verify active 2026–27 window, exact slab/amount, and current circular on the official portal before applying.

anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: सरकारी CFC या CSC केंद्र पर केवल निर्धारित सेवा शुल्क (₹0–₹50) व पक्की रसीद लागू
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Nominal authorized CFC/CSC facilitation fee only (always take printed receipt)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
